purpose: Teacher-authored learning scaffolds and curriculum routing metadata; not a copy of NCERT textbook content and not a replacement for textbook verification.

content_policy.note: NCERT textbook reuse restrictions are recorded in source_registry.json. Do not ingest or redistribute full textbook text without permission. Add exact source/page references only after authorized review.

lesson_contract.source_policy: Curriculum claims must be grounded in approved retrieved source chunks. If unavailable, label as general explanation and do not claim textbook verification.

language_policy.English: Natural age-appropriate English. Explain terminology, then use it consistently.
language_policy.Tanglish: Natural Tamil-English code-switching written in Latin script; keep essential scientific/mathematical terms clear; do not return English-only text; captions must match spoken text.
